fields.climate: tropical; rainy, monsoon season (May to November); dry season (December to April); little seasonal temperature variation
fields.terrain: mostly low, flat plains; mountains in southwest and north
fields.hazards: monsoonal rains (June to November); flooding; occasional droughts
fields.resources: oil and gas, timber, gemstones, iron ore, manganese, phosphates, hydropower potential, arable land
fields.farm: cassava, rice, maize, sugarcane, vegetables, oil palm fruit, rubber, bananas, jute, pork
fields.exports: garments, semiconductors, trunks and cases, footwear, gold
fields.industries: tourism, garments, construction, rice milling, fishing, wood and wood products, rubber, cement, gem mining, textiles
fields.languages: Khmer (official) 95.8%, minority languages 2.9%, Chinese 0.6%, Vietnamese 0.5%, other 0.2%
fields.legal: civil law system (influenced by the UN Transitional Authority in Cambodia), customary law, Communist legal theory, and common law
fields.military: 18 is the legal minimum age for military service for men and women
